main_text.l: Christum esse virtute & natura inferiorem Melchisedeco, Melchisedeciani.
Christum Patri ὁμοιούσιον tantum, Acatiani, Samiarriani, Macedoniani.
Diuinam Christi naturam quædam ignorafse, Agnoetæ.
Diuinam naturam in Christo fuisse tantum post incarnationem, Monophysitæ.
Caput Ecclesiæ præter Christum, Papam constituunt Papistæ.
Christum conceptum ex concubitu ad morem caeterorum hominum afferunt Carpocratiani:
Ex Iosephi & Mariæ coitu, Ebionitæ, Cerinthiani, Theodotiani.
Christum in carne venisse & hominem factum negant Simoniani, Christolytæ, Proclitæ.
Christum duntaxat fuisse hominem, sed propter maiores progressus virtutum perfectiorem caeteris, Ebionitæ, Cerinthiani, Artemonitæ, Alogi, Theodotiani, Melchisedeciani, Manichæi.

The Greek after "Alogi" is printed in Latin letters ("Alo-gy") and is copied as shown. The page number is not printed. Long s is copied as s; "fuisse" is shown in its normal spelling from the printed "fuiffe".
